question: Show all active customers in the UK.
expected_sql: SELECT id, name, email, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK' AND status = 'active';

question: What is the total number of products in stock across all items?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(stock_quantity) AS total_inventory FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;

question: Find total spending for each customer on completed orders.
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Show completed orders with total amount greater than 200 dollars.
expected_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND total_amount > 200 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: Find the top 2 best-selling products by quantity sold.
expected_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 2;

question: What is the average transaction value of completed orders in London?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND shipping_city = 'London';

question: List payments made via PayPal with their amounts and statuses.
expected_sql: SELECT id, order_id, amount, status, payment_date FROM payments WHERE payment_method = 'paypal';
